[[Player's house|Ruby's house]] }} '''Hanging Around With Slaking II''' (Japanese: '''VS ケッキング II''' ''VS {{tt|Kekking|Slaking}} II''), titled '''VS Slaking II''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 210th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 30th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Misunderstandings''' (Japanese: '''すれ違う心''' ''Uncrossed Hearts'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Uncrossed Hearts''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Norman}} and his {{p|Vigoroth}} continue to get covered in mud produced by [[Mumu]]'s {{m|Mud Shot}}. Norman quickly figures out that {{adv|Ruby}} had lured him to the pipes so that Mumu could shoot the attack through the pipelines. He quickly breaks out and has Vigoroth deflect the attacks, which are sent back at Ruby. Ruby quickly realizes that Norman had figured out his plan and now knows how to counter-attack, but keeps his cool due to having an endless supply of mud to attack with. Inside, the {{tc|Swimmer}}, [[Gabby and Ty|Gabby, and Ty]] watch the battle in shock. Gabby tries to find a way to stop their pointless family struggle, as she needs information about [[Team Magma]] from Ruby and the help of a powerful Trainer like Ruby. Gabby looks around to think of a way to stop them when she finds a board listing some information about {{p|Castform}}. She figures out that not only can Castform change with the weather, but it can control it as well. She begs Castform to help her stop the two from fighting. Back at the battle between Norman and Ruby, Norman has his {{TP|Norman|Slaking}} boost its stats with {{m|Bulk Up}} and swing a staircase at Ruby. Ruby dodges and quickly realizes that Slaking had stopped attacking to build up power, and now that it boosted its stats, it became even stronger. Slaking continues attacking with the staircase, which eventually is placed over the edge of the roof. Cornered, Ruby prepares another pipe and has Mumu prepare another powerful Mud Shot for a final attack. Gabby once again begs Castform to help them, as she does not want to lose important people that can help stop the evil forces in [[Hoenn]]. Castform accepts, and it rushes into the air as Mumu fires another Mud Shot into the pipeline. The Mud Shot reaches Ruby, and he fires a giant ball of mud at his father, only for it to crumble and shrink before it reaches him. The culprit is revealed to be Castform, which had used {{m|Sunny Day}} to dry up the mud, which caused it to crumble and break. Exhausted, Norman and Ruby begin panting, only for the staircase they were standing on to shake and fall off. Back at Ruby's house, [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] sits in her son's room and notes that Ruby didn't read the letter he received from Norman. She guesses that Ruby didn't know that there was a specific reason why they moved to Hoenn, and that they were planning to have a birthday party for him. As Norman and Ruby reach for each other, Ruby's mother reveals that Norman had already accepted his son's decision to do [[Pokémon Contest]]s. ==Major events== * The battle between {{adv|Norman}} and {{adv|Ruby}} continues. * During the battle, Ruby and Norman nearly fall of the edge of the [[Weather Institute]]. * [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] reveals that Norman had already decided to let Ruby take place in Contests. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Gabby and Ty]] * [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] * {{tc|Swimmer}} Jack ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Marshtomp}} ([[Mumu]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Vigoroth}} ({{adv|Norman}}'s) * {{p|Slaking}} ({{OP|Norman|Slaking}}) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo|Mr. Stone]]'s; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Castform|Sunny and Rainy Forms}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 請假王 II|VS Slaking II}} (Taiwan)
